Body.Content:
Scheduling teams planning work over several months need to see upcoming bookings while retaining an hourly view of their schedules. The current hourly view supports up to 28 days. The planned extended view is designed to help teams review bookings across a longer planning horizon without switching to a less detailed view, or paging through multiple time periods. Loading and refresh improvements aim to reduce waiting as teams review and update their schedules.

Administrators can configure the planned capability in schedule board settings to extend the hourly view to up to 180 days. The update also introduces on-demand booking loading and improvements to schedule board loading and refresh performance. Loading screens are improved to reduce full-screen locking during refresh and scrolling. Refresh is designed to cover all bookings in view, helping scheduling teams review changes across the displayed period.

GA date: April CY2027
